design.question: Does a calibration-only interpolated coexact readout have complete prefix coverage and a positive signed response on new texts?
design.knowledge_at_design: V1 stopped with 56/60 active cells and zero treatments. Its coverage and 52 exact-zero atlas nodes are known. No v2 lookup sweep, evaluation-prefix query or response has been performed. Eight neighbors is a single prospective choice, not a selected winner.
design.atlas_policy: Reuse the exact v1 calibration-only PCA, node field and raw-hidden dose. Bind the original atlas receipts and byte-identical model/runtime; do not refit on v1 or v2 evaluation data.

lookup.selection: Euclidean nearest eight calibration nodes, stable frozen-index tie breaking; no component-activity filtering
lookup.weights: exp(-0.5*(distance/bandwidth)^2), normalized across the eight selected nodes; no exact-match override
lookup.coexact: weighted sum of raw calibration chart coexact vectors, including zero and inactive vectors; normalize only the resulting hidden-space direction
lookup.support: nearest distance within the unchanged v1 radius AND eighth distance within the 0.99 higher-quantile leave-one-calibration-prompt-out eighth distance
lookup.cancellation: If the interpolated coexact norm is below threshold, abstain with zero deltas for both arms; no alternate neighbor set or redraw.
lookup.random_control: At each calibration node, seed by (seed,node_index), draw a Gaussian chart vector, normalize it and multiply by the raw coexact node norm. Interpolate with identical nodes/weights, then normalize the aggregate in hidden space. Exact-zero nodes contribute zero. A below-threshold aggregate control makes the cell ineligible for that seed; no redraw.
lookup.name_boundary: Interpolated calibration-coexact readout, not an orthogonal Hodge decomposition on evaluation points or a globally smooth field. The legacy component labels remain coexact and random_tangent.

data.novelty: New IDs, normalized texts and authored scenario labels; audit all historical data JSONL suites including v1 pilot/evaluation. Same authored families, not an external or stylistically independent sample.
data.selection: Keep the first-authored texts; no response-based replacement or reuse of v1 evaluation prefixes. No new model training.

inherited: all 60 cells required before nonzero treatment
same signed odd coefficient and prompt bootstrap
excluded_claims: pure readout-only effect versus v1 (new texts and random control also differ)

geometry.pca_fit_scope: concatenated L7 token states from calibration texts only
geometry.graph_scope: one graph per calibration trajectory, all in the same fixed PCA chart; pool their nodes after decomposition
geometry.lookup: one nearest calibration node, Euclidean chart distance; first frozen node wins ties
geometry.delta_scale: median of the 40 per-prompt median raw-hidden centered-step norms; calibration only
geometry.null: isotropic Gaussian in the frozen PCA span, keyed by seed and frozen node index; hidden-space unit norm
geometry.normalization_boundary: PCA backprojection defines a candidate intervention direction, not an exact inverse of hidden-state L2 normalization.

evaluation.baseline: unhooked batch-12 with exactly the same prefix IDs as treatment
evaluation.target_access: only the scorer reads input_ids[prefix_length]; no target or suffix goes to hidden extraction, lookup, normalization, sign selection or RNG
evaluation.cache_policy: no mutable KV cache shared between prefixes or arms

analysis.primary: signed odd coexact-minus-random next-token log-probability coefficient
analysis.aggregation: mean over 8 seeds, then mean over all 3 fixed prefixes, then equal-weight mean over 20 prompts
analysis.pass_rule: all 60 planned prompt/prefix cells valid and 95 percent lower prompt-bootstrap endpoint strictly positive
analysis.missing_policy: preflight every evaluation cell before nonzero treatment; any unsupported/zero/nonfinite direction yields INSUFFICIENT_COVERAGE with the complete support table and no reduced-sample estimate
secondary: raw coexact and random signed responses versus baseline

runtime_gate.source_weight_bytes: all native-FP32 parameters must match before and after execution

future_invariance_gate.comparison: byte equality within a fixed runtime, seed, alpha and batch shape
future_invariance_gate.scope: Core NumPy tests are necessary but do not replace an integrated model-runner audit.

readout.selection: Euclidean nearest eight calibration nodes, stable frozen-index tie breaking; no component-activity filtering
readout.weights: exp(-0.5*(distance/bandwidth)^2), normalized across the eight selected nodes; no exact-match override
readout.coexact: weighted sum of raw calibration chart coexact vectors, including zero and inactive vectors; normalize only the resulting hidden-space direction
readout.support: nearest distance within the unchanged v1 radius AND eighth distance within the 0.99 higher-quantile leave-one-calibration-prompt-out eighth distance
readout.cancellation: If the interpolated coexact norm is below threshold, abstain with zero deltas for both arms; no alternate neighbor set or redraw.
readout.random_control: At each calibration node, seed by (seed,node_index), draw a Gaussian chart vector, normalize it and multiply by the raw coexact node norm. Interpolate with identical nodes/weights, then normalize the aggregate in hidden space. Exact-zero nodes contribute zero. A below-threshold aggregate control makes the cell ineligible for that seed; no redraw.

prompts.text: The watchmaker placed a small brass spring beside the measuring scale, checked its tension twice, and entered the result in a notebook before opening the next drawer of replacement parts for the damaged clock.

Her patience was a reservoir beneath the conversation, receiving every interruption without a ripple until a careless joke opened the smallest crack in the wall and the room suddenly heard the pressure gathering behind her silence.

The archivist found a signature that insisted it had written the novelist, not the novel, and each attempt to identify the original hand produced another biography in which the same ink described a different human life.

At the market, Wednesday was sold by weight, wrapped in yesterday's rain, and carried home in a basket whose handle kept asking whether the afternoon should be cooked before the guests arrived without their names.

The research team secured a temperature sensor to the metal pole, checked the battery connection, and recorded its position before returning along the marked route to the shelter where the remaining equipment was stored for winter.

The delivery driver stacked the flour sacks beside the bakery entrance, counted them against the printed order, and asked the morning supervisor to sign the receipt before moving the empty cart back into the parked van.

The musician loosened the violin strings carefully, adjusted the bridge with both hands, and tightened each string a little at a time while listening for the familiar pitch that would indicate the instrument was ready for rehearsal.

The gardener lifted the shallow planter from its tray, removed the leaves blocking the drainage holes, and added fresh water until a small stream appeared beneath the pot and ran toward the corner of the rooftop.

The station worker walked along the empty platform, tested each emergency telephone, and marked the damaged cover on the inspection sheet before returning to the office to report the repairs needed before the afternoon service began.

Regret ran beneath his ordinary sentences like an underground river, touching the roots of every cheerful story until a question about the old apartment brought cold water suddenly to the surface of an otherwise comfortable evening.

The rumor was a loose stitch in the neighborhood's coat, almost invisible at first, but every repetition pulled another thread until the familiar pattern of greetings began to separate into small and unexpectedly distant pieces of cloth.

His ambition built a staircase through every conversation, adding another step whenever someone mentioned a possible opportunity, until he could no longer see the people waiting at the bottom or remember why he had started climbing.

Their agreement lay between them like thin ice over dark water, clear enough to reflect a peaceful sky but trembling whenever either person placed the weight of an old accusation upon the careful silence of the meeting.

Hope crossed the long hospital corridor like a lighthouse beam, briefly illuminating each closed door before moving onward, while the waiting families turned toward the same small brightness and then settled again into the uncertain hours ahead.

The translator woke convinced that she was the language she had spent her life studying, and when her brother asked for her name, she answered with a grammatical rule that still carried the unmistakable warmth of her voice.

The mask recognized the actor as one of its former expressions, refusing to accept that a person could exist behind the painted face, and every rehearsal became an argument about which of them had originally learned to speak.

The family recipe declared itself the grandmother of everyone who cooked it, recalling births that had occurred before its first written copy and correcting the relatives whenever they described it as a collection of instructions rather than a person.

The referee gradually became the boundary line he was supposed to watch, feeling each crossing as a decision about his own existence, while the players continued to ask where the official had gone and who could settle their dispute.

The pianist heard a chord introduce him as its instrument, explaining that his childhood and careful practice were merely ways of tuning the hands through which it intended to appear when the audience finally stopped speaking and began to listen.

Silence rented a bicycle from the corner shop, paid with three unfinished arguments, and rode uphill toward a village where every doorstep was busy translating the smell of rain into instructions for opening a window inside a song.

The border sat beside the fireplace knitting a question from the footsteps of passing travelers, occasionally borrowing a vowel from the smoke to repair the places where an answer had begun to unravel into a country without a horizon.

Distance buried an appointment beneath the staircase, watered it with a carefully folded echo, and waited until a new direction began growing through the floorboards to announce that the journey had arrived several miles before its own beginning.

Permission painted the season on the inside of a bell, then invited the weather to inspect the color while a queue of forgotten addresses rehearsed the sound they would make when the first brushstroke finally learned to ring.

Grammar measured the shadow with a spoonful of tomorrow, divided the result among several sleeping verbs, and sent the remainder to a workshop where the shape of a promise was being repaired with pieces of unspoken daylight.

novelty_audit.scope: Repository data JSONL suites only; overlap score is descriptive, not an admission threshold. Authored new strings, not a random or external sample; no claim about training exposure or novel syntax/style.

execution_details.pilot_nonzero_deltas: compare all nominal float32 delta bytes without applying them
execution_details.evaluation_order: preparation prompt order, prefix 8/16/24, seed 0..7, component, alpha
execution_details.bootstrap_rng: numpy.random.default_rng(1729), 5000 by 20 integer indices over sorted prompt IDs
execution_details.preparation_receipts: validate the pinned preparation and its original file inventory; new stage sources are additional
execution_details.nonfinite_direction_status: INSUFFICIENT_COVERAGE; other runtime/input errors are INVALID_INPUT_OR_NUMERICS
